description.text:
7 single-target physical attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, Lv.3 En-Lightning, En-Lightning Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Lightning Damage +20%, Physical Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Lightning ability with Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns/3 turns/15 seconds to user/party/party with at least 0/3/4 Warrior I members (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Lightning, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Rapid Spark+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Synaptic Net Dive+: 0.825s CT, Higher multiplier after 3 uses; Transparent+: 1.2s CT, Instant Cast 1 to user
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
